command: GMX --version
GMX check -f RUN\md.xtc
GMX trjconv -s RUN\md.tpr -f RUN\md.xtc -o md-whole.xtc -pbc mol
GMX trjconv -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-whole.xtc -o md-center.xtc -center -pbc mol
GMX trjconv -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -o md-fit.xtc -fit rot+trans
GMX trjconv -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -o md-reference0.pdb -dump 0
GMX trjconv -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -o md-last.pdb -dump 100
GMX rms -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -o rmsd-ca.xvg -tu ps
GMX rms -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -o rmsd-backbone.xvg -tu ps
GMX rms -s md-last.pdb -f md-center.xtc -o rmsd-ca-lastref.xvg -tu ps
GMX rmsf -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -o rmsf-ca.xvg -res
GMX gyrate -h
GMX gyrate -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -o gyrate.xvg -sel group "Protein"
GMX sasa -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -o sasa.xvg -surface group "Protein" -output group "Protein"

GMX hbond -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -r group "Protein" -t group "Protein" -num hbond-protein.xvg -dan hbond-donors-acceptors.xvg -dist hbond-distances.xvg -ang hbond-angles.xvg -o hbond-protein.ndx
GMX dssp -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -sel group "Protein" -o dssp.dat -num dssp-count.xvg
GMX distance -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-center.xtc -select (group "Protein" and resnr 35 and name CA) plus (group "Protein" and resnr 52 and name CA) -oall distance-glu35-asp52.xvg
GMX energy -f RUN\nvt.edr -o nvt-temperature.xvg
GMX energy -f RUN\npt.edr -o npt-pressure-density.xvg
GMX energy -f RUN\npt.edr -o npt-pressure.xvg
GMX energy -f RUN\npt.edr -o npt-density.xvg
GMX covar -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-fit.xtc -o eigenvalues.xvg -v eigenvectors.trr -av pca-average.pdb
GMX anaeig -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-fit.xtc -v eigenvectors.trr -first 1 -last 2 -proj pca-projection.xvg -2d pca-2d.xvg
GMX cluster -s RUN\md.tpr -f md-fit.xtc -method gromos -cutoff 0.10 -g cluster.log -dist cluster-rmsd-distribution.xvg -o cluster-rmsd.xpm -sz cluster-sizes.xvg -cl cluster-representatives.pdb
GMX sham -f pca-2d.xvg -notime -ngrid 8 8 8 -tsham 300 -ls fel.xpm -g sham.log
GMX check -f md-center.xtc
